source_description: Hourly archive for the Canso grid point: ERA5 reanalysis for every model field, and the station observation for visibility, which no reanalysis carries.

field_sources.visibility: observed at PORT HAWKESBURY (ECCC climate id 8204495) via https://api.weather.gc.ca/collections/climate-hourly/items; unreported hours from gfs_seamless via https://historical-forecast-api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast

method: bins: for each (month, UTC hour), n is the number of archive hours with every evaluated field present, and p_launch is the fraction of them at which no evaluated criterion was violated. daily_window: for each month, n is the number of local days whose whole evaluation window is present, and p_launch is the fraction of them with no violation at any window hour, which is the event L(d) the forecast evaluates. p_violation is the per-criterion violation frequency. A bin is flagged low_confidence when n is below min_samples_per_bin or when the frequency is exactly 0 or 1.

evaluation_window_local.source: Canso Spaceport Facility Environmental Assessment Registration Document (Strum Consulting for Maritime Launch Services, June 2018), section 2.3. The spec repeats it as the nominal operating hours (spec IV.5).
evaluation_window_local.source_quote: The majority of launches will be conducted between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m.
evaluation_window_local.use: The frozen Seam 1 signature takes a date and no time, so the window interval I(d) of spec II.20 is these hours. Hourly values labelled 07:00 to 12:00 local, both included, are evaluated.
